items.exampleEn: A small stone flew up from the road and cracked our windshield.
items.exampleZh: 路上一顆小石子飛起來，把我們的擋風玻璃打出裂痕。

items.exampleEn: The wreck of an old plane in the forest is now covered with moss.
items.exampleZh: 森林裡一架老飛機的殘骸，現在長滿了青苔。

items.exampleEn: They rented a yacht for the day to celebrate their wedding anniversary.
items.exampleZh: 他們租了一天遊艇來慶祝結婚紀念日。

items.exampleEn: Our cruise liner stopped at four islands during the ten-day trip.
items.exampleZh: 我們搭的郵輪在十天的旅程中停靠了四座島。

items.exampleEn: The company outing this year will be a picnic by the lake.
items.exampleZh: 今年的公司出遊是在湖邊野餐。

items.exampleEn: My foot slipped off the bike pedal on the steep hill.
items.exampleZh: 在陡坡上，我的腳從腳踏車踏板上滑了下來。

items.exampleEn: A walker found my lost wallet on the mountain path and called me.
items.exampleZh: 一位步行經過的人在山路上撿到我遺失的錢包，還打電話給我。

items.exampleEn: Some birds use the sun for navigation when they fly south for the winter.
items.exampleZh: 有些鳥在冬天往南飛時，會靠太陽導航。

items.sentenceEn: The rain was so heavy that I could hardly see through the windshield.
items.sentenceZh: 雨大到我幾乎看不清擋風玻璃外面。

items.audioEn: Our class outing to the zoo is next Thursday, so bring lunch and comfortable shoes.
items.audioZh: 我們班下週四去動物園出遊，請帶午餐和舒服的鞋子。
items.questionZh: 說話者提醒大家帶什麼？
options: A warm jacket and a hat

items.sentenceEn: Push the pedal slowly, and the car will start to move.
items.sentenceZh: 慢慢踩下踏板，車子就會開始移動。

items.sentenceEn: The car's navigation system took us the wrong way twice.
items.sentenceZh: 車上的導航系統兩次帶我們走錯路。

items.stemEn: The rich businessman spends his summers sailing on his private ____.
items.stemZh: 那位富有的商人夏天都在他的私人遊艇上航行。

items.stemEn: After the storm, the old fishing boat was a complete ____.
items.stemZh: 暴風雨過後，那艘舊漁船完全成了一堆殘骸。

items.passageEn: For our family outing last Sunday, we visited a sea museum near the harbor. The first room showed the story of a famous ocean liner from a hundred years ago, with photos of its grand restaurants and dance halls. Next, we saw the wreck of a small wooden boat that divers had found nearby. My father, who loves maps, spent an hour learning about old navigation tools. Outside, a beautiful yacht was tied up at the dock, and walkers stopped to take photos. On the way home, we rented bikes and pedaled along the coast as the sun went down.
items.passageZh: 上週日的家庭出遊，我們參觀了港口附近的一座海洋博物館。第一個展間介紹一百年前一艘知名遠洋客輪的故事，還有它華麗餐廳和舞廳的照片。接著，我們看到潛水員在附近找到的一艘小木船的殘骸。爸爸很愛地圖，花了一個小時研究古老的導航工具。館外，一艘漂亮的遊艇停靠在碼頭，散步的人紛紛停下來拍照。回家路上，我們租了腳踏車，在夕陽下沿著海岸騎車。

options: 各式各樣的古老導航工具

questions.questionZh: 爸爸花了一個小時做什麼？

items.promptZh: 這條步道很受散步的人和騎單車的人歡迎。
referenceEn: This trail is popular with walkers and cyclists.
Walkers and people on bikes love this path.
rubricZh: walker 指散步的人，常用複數（例如 popular with walkers）

items.instructionZh: 用 navigation 造一個句子，說說你開車、騎車或走路時怎麼找路。
referenceEn: I always use the navigation system in my car when I drive somewhere new.
I am not good at navigation, so I always ask people for directions when I walk.
